meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按六阶段流程重构代码：先确认意图、扫代码库、评估测试覆盖、生成计划，再逐步修改并每步跑测试验证。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取等代码改动时触发；目标或范围不清时，它会先提问确认再动手。

say.note: 按默认 module 范围、safe 策略重构该文件

say.text: 把验证逻辑抽成单独的模块
say.note: 它会先确认目标和范围，再出计划

howto.what_en: After install, Claude refactors code in six phases: confirm intent, map the codebase, assess test coverage, generate a plan, then edit step by step, running tests after each step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract or modernize code; if the target or scope is unclear, it asks you first.

Widen the scope to the whole codebase

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic into its own module
say_en.note: It confirms goal and scope, then plans
